result.instructions: Tools for Bouncify, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many Bouncify verification credits remain?"; "Verify this email after I confirm the credit usage."; "Upload this email list without starting verification, then check its job status.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Bouncify data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run bouncify_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run bouncify_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run bouncify_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. bouncify_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: bouncify_credit_balance
tools.title: Read Bouncify credits
tools.description: Read available Bouncify verification credits without verifying any email.

tools.name: bouncify_verify_email
tools.title: Verify one email with Bouncify
tools.description: Verify one address with a 30-second vendor timeout. Can spend Bouncify credits and requires confirm:true. Unknown and catch-all results do not guarantee delivery. Never automatically retry an uncertain response.

tools.name: bouncify_create_bulk_list
tools.title: Upload a Bouncify email list
tools.description: Upload 1–1,000 email addresses as a new list with auto_verify:false. Does not start verification. Creates stored vendor data and requires confirm:true. Use bouncify_start_bulk_verification after the job becomes ready.

tools.name: bouncify_start_bulk_verification
tools.title: Start Bouncify bulk verification
tools.description: Start a ready uploaded list. Can spend credits for every address, cannot be paused or cancelled, and requires confirm:true. Check job status and the dashboard before resubmitting an uncertain request.

tools.name: bouncify_bulk_status
tools.title: Read Bouncify bulk status
tools.description: Read one existing job's preparation, verification progress and aggregate result counts. Does not start verification or download address-level results. Wait between polls; API docs specify 120 requests per minute.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Bouncify
prompts.description: What you can do with Bouncify here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_credits_before_cleaning_a_list
prompts.title: Check credits before cleaning a list
prompts.description: Read the available Bouncify verification balance before planning an email check or bulk job.

prompts.name: verify_an_email_collected_at_signup
prompts.title: Verify an email collected at signup
prompts.description: After confirming credit usage, check one email and review its verification result. Treat unknown and catch-all results as inconclusive.

prompts.name: prepare_an_email_list_for_verification
prompts.title: Prepare an email list for verification
prompts.description: Confirm the upload of up to 1,000 addresses, then check when the stored list is ready. Verification starts through a separate confirmed action.

prompts.name: run_an_approved_bulk_verification_job
prompts.title: Run an approved bulk verification job
prompts.description: Confirm credit usage to start a ready list, then check progress and aggregate verification counts. Wait between status checks.
